title: Доказать archive allowlists, migrations и clean consumers
summary: Собрать фактические private/local package artifacts PHP, Dart core и Dart MCP companion, установить их в disposable consumers без workspace source imports и выпустить digest-bound P7 receipt.
why: Source-tree tests share autoload, caches and relative paths with implementation; only archive listing plus clean installation detects leaked reference/test files, broken manifests, accidental exports and migration snippets that compile only inside the monorepo. `RAG:—`.

include: Deterministic package staging; Composer archive and Dart publication-preview inventories; exact allow/deny rules; checksums; disposable PHP/Dart/Dart-MCP consumers; documented stable scenario and migration snippets; no-workspace-import proof; production default dependency graph; integrated surface/archive/consumer receipt and P8–P10 residuals.
exclude: Packagist/pub.dev upload; public tag/version/license decision; hosted replacement for Dart path dependency; CI workflow/permissions, lowest/latest matrices, SBOM/provenance; mutation/fuzz/performance; final release acceptance or marketing docs.

reads.why: Source input; exact context is preserved in item sections.

rules: Build in `mktemp -d` from tracked source and never mutate the owner workspace. Every artifact records builder command, source tree, sorted file list, size and SHA-256. Consumers install/extract only staged artifacts; source/path access outside the staging root is denied and scanned. PHP production consumer uses `--no-dev`; Dart core consumer imports only supported public libraries. MCP companion is tested as a paired private artifact preserving its declared local dependency and report labels the path dependency `public-release-blocked`, not green publication evidence. All deny patterns are exact and a forbidden-file mutant proves each gate.
guidance: One stdlib Python orchestrator may call package-native commands transparently and retain argv/exit/duration/digests. Do not invent a second CI workflow or hide commands behind a generic pass. Preserve raw listings as JSON data and render Markdown from them. Consumer scenarios stay minimal and product-neutral: one safe public flow, one testkit-only setup in a development consumer, and one MCP wrapper construction/fixture path. Failed smoke points back to the owning P7.2/P7.3 delta.

validation.expect: Source acceptance condition preserved in Validation section.

deliverables: Reproducible private package artifacts, exact archive inventories/checksums, three clean-consumer receipts, compiled migration proof and integrated P7 package-boundary verdict.

result.notes:
tools/package_gate.py + consumers/php|dart|dart_mcp; P7-package-gate.json GREEN. PHP archive 155 files; Dart walk 184 (conformance via .pubignore); MCP path dep public-release-blocked; repeat digest match; clean consumers + migration snippets; private/local receipt only.
